story.title: Cloudflare cuts 1,100 jobs citing AI efficiency gains even as revenue hits record high
story.summary: Cloudflare announced its first large-scale layoff, eliminating approximately 1,100 positions predominantly in support roles, with CEO Matthew Prince attributing the cuts directly to AI-driven efficiency improvements. The company simultaneously reported record-high revenue, making it one of the clearest corporate admissions yet that AI is displacing workers even in financially healthy firms. The announcement underscores a growing pattern where AI productivity gains decouple job retention from business growth.
